title: Extension of Smoking Prohibition Zone to Cover Five-metre Radius of Playgrounds or Exercise Areas
what_it_is: Extension of Smoking Prohibition Zone to Cover Five-metre Radius of Playgrounds or Exercise Areas

sections.label: Smoking prohibition in public places
sections.summary: The Ministry aims to prohibit smoking in all public places and has banned it in over 32,000 premises, playgrounds and exercise areas, and will consider a five-metre radius extension.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: My Ministry's long-term goal is to prohibit smoking in all public places to protect non-smokers from the harmful effects of second-hand smoke.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Smoking is already prohibited in more than 32,000 premises, including shopping malls, hospitals, schools, bus-stops, covered walkways and common areas of residential premises or buildings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Playgrounds and exercise areas are also places where smoking is currently prohibited.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To protect users of such facilities against second-hand smoke, the smoking prohibition is applicable to any sidewalk, chair, bench or amenity adjacent to the playground or exercise area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: My Ministry will take into account the Member's suggestion to include any area within a radius of five metres from the outer edge of the playground or exercise areas when extending the smoking prohibition in future.

sections.label: Extending smoking prohibited areas
sections.summary: The Ministry will consider extending the smoking prohibited area to a five-metre radius from playgrounds and exercise areas, and is monitoring and looking into extending some smoking areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As mentioned in my earlier reply, we will take into account the Member's suggestion to extend the smoking prohibited area to within a five-metre radius from the outer edge of the playground and exercise areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have noted earlier, the smoking prohibited areas have been extended to all sidewalks and these areas could already be well within the suggested five-metre radius.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Should there be actual cases, perhaps a gentle and polite reminder asking the smoker to move away may well do the trick.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are monitoring and also looking into an extension of some of these smoking areas.
